edits.new: Which information admitted by Alert messages falls outside Automated fire messages, particularly its exclusion of subscriber recipients?
edits.old: Can a subscriber-addressed message about a service interruption satisfy Alert messages while falling outside Automated fire messages?

edits.new: Which information admitted by Automated fire messages falls outside Alert messages when the subscriber-recipient restriction applies only to its service-interruption alternative?
edits.old: Can a message reporting a detected fire, with no subscriber addressed, fall outside Alert messages because it lacks the subscriber-recipient condition?
